data.title: Making Ten to Add 8 + 5
data.description: Help a friend see why making ten first makes adding quick.

challenges.prompt: Help Pip see why 8 + 5 is quick when you make ten first.

teach.holds: I have to count all of them one at a time, 1, 2, 3, all the way up.
teach.idea: Two from the five fills the ten, and ten and three is thirteen.
presses: But why move any counters? I can just count them.
Okay, but how do you know what is left over?

challenges.key: Two from the five fills the ten, and ten and three is thirteen.

reasons: an idea said in the child's own words +1.2

levers.when: the learner misses once or is stuck
levers.says: Look at the frame. How many empty squares are in the ten?
